## PreflightCheckError.code property

The Node.js errno code (for example `EACCES`<!-- -->, `EPERM`<!-- -->, `EISDIR`<!-- -->) from the underlying filesystem failure, present only for a `'config-read'` failure and only when the cause exposed a string errno code. Lets a consumer distinguish a permission problem from another read failure when phrasing the remediation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
code?: string | undefined;
```
